Harkesh Manuja, J. (Oral)
[1]. The landowner is in appeal seeking enhancement of compensation for the acquired land.

[2].  Brief facts of the case are that vide notification dated 26.07.1979, issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act 1894 ( for short "the Act"), land situated in the area of village Jandiala Guru,
Tehsil and District istrict Amritsar was acquired by the State of Punjab for development of new Mandi Township at Jandiala Guru.
The same was followed by notification dated 27.02.1980 issued under Section 6 of the Act.
The Land Acquisition Collector (for short "the Collector")) assessed the market value of the acquired land @ 17,000/- per acre for Chahi and 5,000/ 5,000/- per acre for Gair Mumkin..
The landowner feeling dissatisfied with the award of the Collector, filed objections.

Considering the material placed 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:086408 on record, the Gurdial Singh vs L.A.C on 11 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56089612/
1 learned learned court below vide its award dated 21.01.1993 determined the market value of the acquired land @ 40,000/- per acre.

sentences.text: [3]. Learned State counsel fairly submitted that the claim made in the present appeal is squarely covered by the judgment of this Court in RFA No. 2767 of 1994,, titled as 'Suba Suba Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab and others', others decided on 10.11.2008, whereby the compensation for the acquired land was enhanced from 40,000/- per acre to 45,000/- per acre.

entities.text: Suba Suba Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab and others', others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: [4]. In addition, though a claim has also been set up on behalf of the appellant/landowner seeking compensation/enhancement towards fruit bearing trees

, however,
from the perusal of paper book as well as records, it can be seen that no evidence was ever led by the appellant/landowner in support of such claim, thus, in these circumstances, the enhancement sought for towards fruit bearing trees is declined.
[5]. In view of above, qua enhancement of compensation pensation for the acquired land, the present appeal stands disposed of in terms of detailed led reasons recorded in Suba Singh's case (supra).
(supra) All pending application application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
Needless to mention that the appellant shall be entitled to the statutory benefits as well as interest as per the Act.
(HARKESH MANUJA)
July 11, 2024 JUDGE Atik
